initial_findings.heel: Initial failures traced to a toe-side proxy marker and omitted future approach; resolved by heel-side projection and correct approach prediction.
initial_findings.procedural_torso: New shot styles reached 0.58 rad; reduced final torso cap to 0.52 rad and confirmed rendered action tests.
initial_findings.reception_assertion: The initial full-body-only assertion rejected a valid upper-body chest overlay with accepted plan and actual trunk contact. Updated to require accepted planning and real trunk contact for that overlay, then repeated the reception/tactical suite.
initial_findings.tactical_assertion: A real quick CPU outlet can start before the added tactical classifier confirms possession. The regression now also measures that executed native pass: same-team CPU actor/target, 4-35 m range, more than 2 m opponent clearance along the lane and more than 1 m forward progress; diagnostic labels alone are not required.
initial_findings.superseded_validation_queue: Stopped after its current two cases completed; only completed passing cases are included as supplementary evidence.

limits: Rendered tests run on Linux/X11 with a virtual Xbox controller, not a Windows GUI or physical Xbox device.
Windows executable, imported DLL closure, package assets and launchers are statically verified against the fresh cross-build.
Profiles are bounded procedural upper-body adaptations of native clips, not thousands of new captures, a learned control policy or Euphoria.
The metadata-compatible profile/source pairs have not all been visually tested; tests cover the recorded contexts and scenarios.
Controlled native ground dribbling retains its established collision exemption; these tests do not establish universal absence of body interpenetration.
